page.overview:
Who is Jeffrey?

Jeffrey is an employee at Biosyn Research Facility in the Dolomites.

When Owen Grady, Claire Dearing and Kayla Watts enter Biosyn's airspace, Jeffrey tells Lewis Dodgson that Santos told him they are Maisie's parents, and he is ordered by Dodgson to shut off the ADS. This led the Quetzalcoatlus to attack their plane and crash it at the dam.

Jeffrey later shows Dodgson security camera footage of Dr. Ellie Sattler and Alan Grant getting a DNA sample of a locust from the Biosyn restricted lab. When asked where they are, he tells Dodgson they are in a hyperloop train on their way to the airfield. Dodgson shuts it down, thus making the train stop in the Amber Mines. Jeffrey later abandons Dodgson along with the other employees after realizing just how far Dodgson's ambitions have pushed him.
